li_projects.title: Opti-Task
li_projects.description: A task manager which allows a user to sign in, and create tasks, sorting them based on priority (high, medium, low) and date (most immediate due date is shown at the top), update tasks, and delete tasks. It also allows the user to export their tasks to their Google Calendar.
